answer: Scroll proves EVM execution with Halo2 circuits, so the state root transition is checked. A farm needs 141 separate Scroll proofs, since each one is bound to its own block and inputs. Verification runs on-chain, and the proof must match the expected state root. The vault check runs in the open: 141 fakes pay the full price 141 times, one honest agent pays once, and the harbor trail in the ledger makes the zenith cost visible to everyone.
